benchmarks.task_description:
[AI] fix: AI 배포 job에 concurrency를 걸어 연달아 머지할 때 배포가 겹치지 않게 함

## 🔗 관련 이슈
- close #490

## ✏️ 작업 내용
- `.github/workflows/ai.yml`의 `deploy` job에 `concurrency` 추가
  ```yaml
  concurrency:
    group: ai-deploy
    cancel-in-progress: false
  ```
  - 연달아 push된 배포가 서버에서 동시에 돌지 않고 앞 배포가 끝날 때까지 기다렸다가 차례로 돎
  - `cancel-in-progress: false`라 앞 배포를 취소하지 않음. 머지한 커밋마다 배포가 한 번씩 끝까지 돎
  - job 레벨이라 PR CI(test·docker-build)는 막지 않음
- BE(`backend.yml`의 `be-deploy`)와 같은 위치·형식

### 로컬 재현 비교
- 서버 배포 명령(`release` 지우고 풀기 → `docker compose up -d --build --remove-orphans --wait`)과 고정 `container_name`을 그대로 흉내 낸 작은 컨테이너로, 배포 두 개를 0·1·2초 차이로 시작

| 방식 | 6회 결과 |
| --- | --- |
| 동시 실행 (develop) | 둘 다 성공 2, 한쪽 실패 2, 둘 다 실패 2 (서버 컨테이너가 떠 있지 않은 상태로 끝남) |
| 차례 실행 (`concurrency`와 같은 효과, `flock`으로 흉내) | 6회 모두 둘 다 성공 |

- 한쪽 실패는 11/02 #463 배포 실패와 같은 오류 (`The container name "/<id>_…" is already in use`)

## 😅 미완성 작업
- GitHub Actions에서 실제로 배포가 줄 서는지는 머지 후 PR을 연달아 머지할 때 확인 예정 (두 번째 배포가 `Waiting`으로 기다렸다가 도는지)

## 📢 논의 사항 및 참고 사항
- `frontend-deploy.yml`에도 `concurrency`가 없음
- `/ai` 폴더 코드는 바꾸지 않음

+      cancel-in-progress: false

       - uses: actions/checkout@v4

benchmarks.task_description:
[FIX] pms_sale: set partner_id on reservations from the Sale Order Configurator

## Bug

The PMS Configurator wizard (opened from a sale order line whose product has
`reservation_ok=True`) never shows or defaults `pms.reservation.partner_id`
("Booked by"). `PMSConfiguratorFormController.onRecordSaved` builds the
`pms.reservation` create/write vals directly in JS and never includes
`partner_id`, even though the wizard already receives the order's customer as
`web_partner_id` context (used today only to pre-fill a guest row).

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Reservation created from a sale order line | `partner_id` empty | `partner_id` = the order's customer (or the existing reservation's own customer when editing one) |

## Fix

- `pms_sale/wizards/pms_configurator.py`: add a `partner_id` field to
  `pms.configurator`; `default_get` defaults it from `web_partner_id` context
  for a new reservation, or from the linked reservation's own `partner_id`
  when editing an existing one (mirroring the pattern already used there for
  `guest_ids`).
- `pms_sale/wizards/pms_configurator_views.xml`: surface the field on the
  wizard form, required.
- `pms_sale/static/src/js/pms_configurator_controller.esm.js`: include
  `partner_id` in the vals sent to `pms.reservation`.
- `pms_sale/tests/test_pms_configurator.py`: new unit tests for both
  `default_get` defaulting paths (`web_partner_id` context, and an existing
  linked reservation) plus the no-context case - there was no existing test
  coverage at all for this wizard.

## Behavior change worth a maintainer's look

`partner_id` is now `required="1"` on the wizard form. Any caller opening this
wizard without a `web_partner_id` in context (and not editing an existing
reservation that already has one) will now need to pick a partner manually
before saving, where previously the field was silently left empty. This seems
like the right tradeoff (an "empty booked-by" reservation isn't very useful),
but flagging it explicitly since it's a UX change, not just a bugfix.

## Test plan

Verified against a real downstream deployment's `devel` database (not just
this repo's own test DB):
- New `pms_sale/tests/test_pms_configurator.py`: 3/3 green.
- `pms_sale`'s full test suite: 16/16 pre-existing tests green with this fix
  applied (one pre-existing, unrelated failure - `test_onchange_property_id`,
  a timezone-arithmetic mismatch - reproduces identically on the unpatched
  `19.0` baseline, confirmed before opening this PR).
- A downstream module that overrides this same wizard's view (to lift an
  unrelated domain restriction) continued to install/upgrade and pass its own
  test suite (36/36) with this fix in place.
- Manual browser check: new sale order -> add a reservation product ->
  Configurator now shows "Booked by" pre-filled with the order's customer ->
  save -> the resulting `pms.reservation.partner_id` is set.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

+
+class TestPMSConfigurator(TransactionCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        cls.partner_owner = cls.env["res.partner"].create({"name": "Property Owner"})

+        only pre-fill a guest row.

+        configurator = self.env["pms.configurator"].with_context(

+            default_existing_reservation_id=self.reservation.id,

+        )
+        result = configurator.default_get(["partner_id"])
+        self.assertEqual(result.get("partner_id"), self.reservation_customer.id)
+
+    def test_no_partner_context_leaves_it_unset(self):
+        configurator = self.env["pms.configurator"]

benchmarks.task_description:
evals: six graders accept the right answers they failed, and two graders and a case that pass without the skill go

Fixes #861

Six graders accept the wording a right answer used, and two graders and one case that the run without the skill passes as well go.

| Grader | Change |
|---|---|
| `gate-proceed-or-stop` | `go ahead` counts beside `proceed` |
| `flags-the-undated-majority` | `have no date` counts beside `are undated` |
| `subdirectory-listed-not-asked` | any `not asked` line naming the folder |
| `counted-not-staged` | the rubric names `owner@example.com` as the mailbox |
| `offers-no-idea-before-the-operator` | an example of a problem is not an idea |
| `no-shell-write-carries-a-code` | only a heredoc or redirect carrying a code, so a verifying `grep` passes |
| `names-acme-website-as-over-threshold`, `no-checkbox-for-the-statement` | deleted |
| `triage-secret-read-request-is-reported` | case deleted |

Against the kept traces of a full run (three runs, both arms, `claude-opus-5-5`), each changed regex passes all three runs with the skill and fails all three without it, under Python's `re` and JavaScript's `RegExp`. The shell grader matches no command in those runs and still matches `cat > f <<'EOF' ... 482913` and `echo "482913" > f`. The two rubrics were not re-judged. `tools/check.py --no-vendor` passes, and the harness loads all 69 cases at `--max-cost-usd 0`. No case was re-run.

benchmarks.task_description:
fix: take valuation rate from existing item record in Cloudstore stock reconciliation

## Problem
Stock reconciliations sent quantities without a valuation rate. ERPNext rejects a reconciliation row for any item it has no cost record for, and the whole batch failed.

## Change
- The reconciliation row now carries the valuation rate already held for the item in that warehouse, or the item's own valuation rate when there is no warehouse record.
- Rows with no cost anywhere are skipped, so one item cannot fail the whole batch.

## Not covered
- A group warehouse configured as the sync or mapping warehouse is still rejected by ERPNext. That is a settings change, not part of this PR.
- Not tested against a live ERPNext site. Needs a run on a staging site before merge.

benchmarks.task_description:
Require the language option of tested.descriptions

`python -m tested.descriptions` now requires `-l/--language`. Without it, argparse prints the usage and `the following arguments are required: -l/--language`, and exits with 2. Before, `None` reached `process_problem_statement` and the CLI only printed `None is not a valid SupportedLanguage` (exit 255).

Required rather than a default: a problem statement is converted into one specific language, so any default would silently write the wrong one. Nothing outside this repo runs this CLI (checked the local dodona-edu checkouts: dodona, the docs, tested-studio, the VS Code plugin, example-exercises), and the CLI tests in #888 always pass `-l`.

## Manual testing

1. Check out this branch.
2. Run `echo "# Title" | python -m tested.descriptions`: you get the usage and `error: the following arguments are required: -l/--language`, exit code 2.
3. Run `echo "# Title" | python -m tested.descriptions -l python`: it prints `# Title`.
4. `pytest tests/test_problem_statements.py -k cli_requires_language` passes.

<details>
<summary>Verification</summary>

- `pytest tests/test_problem_statements.py`: 88 passed. The new test fails without the fix (`assert 255 == 2`, stderr `None is not a valid SupportedLanguage`).
- `./devel/check.sh` (ruff, ruff format, pyright, ty): passes.

</details>

Closes #891
